Title: The Yoga Sūtras of Patañjali: A New Edition, Translation, and Commentary
Creator: Edwin F. Bryant
Key Themes: Yoga Sūtras, classical yoga, Patañjali, commentary
Notes: The standard modern scholarly translation, with commentary drawing on Vyāsa and the traditional commentators; a lending copy exists on archive.org.

Title: Yoga: Discipline of Freedom — The Yoga Sutra Attributed to Patanjali
Creator: Barbara Stoler Miller
Key Themes: Yoga Sūtras, classical yoga, accessible translation
Notes: Short and highly readable — the better Yoga Sūtras option for A-Level extracts; free lending copy on archive.org.

Title: Roots of Yoga
Creator: James Mallinson, Mark Singleton
Key Themes: yoga history, primary texts, āsana, mantra, meditation
Notes: Translations from 100+ Sanskrit and vernacular yoga texts, many for the first time — the sourcebook for the whole strand.

Title: The Hatha Yoga Pradipika (Pancham Sinh translation)
Creator: Pancham Sinh
Notes: Free public-domain translation of Svātmārāma's 15th-c. haṭha classic with Sanskrit text; dated (1915) — cross-check terminology against Mallinson's modern work.

Title: Yoga Body: The Origins of Modern Posture Practice
Creator: Mark Singleton
Key Themes: modern postural yoga, physical culture, colonial India, invented tradition
Notes: Field-defining and contested argument that globalised posture practice is largely a modern construction — pair with the HAF resource for a classroom debate.

Title: Selling Yoga: From Counterculture to Pop Culture
Creator: Andrea R. Jain
Key Themes: commercialisation, consumer culture, modern yoga, globalisation
Notes: Critical study of yoga's commodification; also engages the Hindu-origins debate directly.

Title: A History of Modern Yoga: Patañjali and Western Esotericism
Creator: Elizabeth De Michelis
Key Themes: modern yoga, Vivekananda, Western esotericism, typology
Notes: The book that founded modern yoga studies; traces Modern Yoga to Vivekananda's 1896 Raja Yoga. Archive.org lending copy linked.

Title: The Haṭha Yoga Project (SOAS)
Creator: SOAS Hatha Yoga Project
Key Themes: haṭha yoga, philology, ethnography, critical editions
Notes: ERC-funded SOAS project (2015–20, PI James Mallinson): critical editions and translations of ten haṭha texts, freely accessible outputs.

Title: Tantra: enlightenment to revolution
Creator: The British Museum
Key Themes: tantra, goddess worship, visual culture, counterculture
Notes: Curated by Imma Ramos; serious treatment of a topic that is easily sensationalised — strong images for classroom use.

Title: Yoga: The Art of Transformation
Creator: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art
Key Themes: yogic art, visual history, sculpture, manuscripts
Notes: World's first exhibition of yogic visual art (Sackler Gallery), 133 works across two millennia — excellent images and framing.

Title: Ayurveda: Knowledge for long life
Creator: Wellcome Collection
Notes: Accessible UK museum introduction to āyurveda; Wellcome also has the 'Ayurvedic Man' exhibition materials.

Title: Light on Yoga
Creator: B.K.S. Iyengar
Key Themes: āsana, prāṇāyāma, practice manual, Iyengar yoga
Notes: The single most influential modern practice manual ('the bible of yoga'); practitioner perspective, shows what modern postural yoga became.

Title: The Heart of Yoga: Developing a Personal Practice
Creator: T.K.V. Desikachar
Notes: Krishnamacharya's son on yoga adapted to the individual; bridges practice and Yoga Sūtras philosophy from inside the tradition.

Title: Tantra Illuminated: The Philosophy, History, and Practice of a Timeless Tradition
Creator: Christopher D. Wallis
Notes: Scholar-practitioner introduction to Śaiva tantra using primary sources; sympathetic insider framing, not peer-reviewed.

Title: Yoga Magazine (Bihar School of Yoga)
Creator: Bihar School of Yoga
Notes: Free archive of the Bihar School's magazine back to 1963 — a primary window onto a living Indian yoga institution; single-tradition perspective.

Title: Hindu Roots of Yoga
Creator: Hindu American Foundation
Key Themes: Take Back Yoga, cultural appropriation, Hindu identity
Notes: Advocacy position from the 'Take Back Yoga' campaign — contested but essential for the who-owns-yoga debate; pair with Singleton and Jain.

Title: Yoga Studies Lecture Series
Creator: Oxford Centre for Hindu Studies
Notes: OCHS's own online lecture series covering global yoga, #MeTooInYoga and consumerism — in-house resource, easy to integrate.

Title: What yoga does to your body and brain
Creator: TED-Ed
Notes: By Krishna Sudhir; the scientific/health angle — useful contrast with the spiritual sources when discussing what 'yoga' now means.

Title: Yoga in Hinduism (Revision World)
Creator: Revision World
Key Themes: karma yoga, jnana yoga, raja yoga, moksha, GCSE
Notes: UK revision page on the yoga paths and moksha; pitched at GCSE so use as scaffolding below A-Level, not as a core text.
